decisionsTitle: «Vreau să apar cu numele în clasament»: an older notice's runner asks to be named in the results
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-01:** "What else do you think we need?" … "Do them all." — among them, a runner who registered under a privacy notice older than the first that described the results should be able to appear by name in a race's published results. §808 had drawn the line — a tick given under the notice that said «Rezultate cu nume nu publicăm încă», with terms that promised to ask separately first, agreed to a list, not to a ranking by name — and left naming those runners to the owner and the lawyer. This is built so that it does **nothing** until the club approves a privacy notice that says so in words: describing the results is not enough.

**Decision.** The separate asking the older terms promised, as the runner's own press on their own registration's page:

- **Where.** «Gestionează înscrierea», the manage page behind the registration's own `MANAGE_REGISTRATION` link (the link in its emails), per person as §547 draws it. The tick reads «Vreau să apar cu numele în clasament» / «I want to appear by name in the results», drawn as a tick (§766: `role="checkbox"`, `aria-checked`, the words naming the setting, 44 pixels), with one sentence on what is published — the name beside the place, race number, time and category, only while the runner is on the public list — and that it is unticked from the same page at any time. While unticked, a sentence says they registered under an older notice and appear only as „Participant #numărul de concurs”; once ticked it is gone, because the published results then name them.
- **The gate is a marker of its own, `{{resultsNameAsk}}`.** Not `{{results}}`: the platform's template names `{{results}}` in section 4 and, in the very next paragraph, tells these runners «Dacă te-ai înscris sub o versiune mai veche a acestei note, care nu descria clasamentul, apari în el doar cu numărul … chiar dacă ai bifat», and that a name appears only for those who ticked «la înscriere». A gate on `{{results}}` would have offered the tick, and published the names, under an approved text that promises the opposite — the day the club approved the template, or at once on a deployment where such a notice is already in force. So, as `{{rsvpAskAnswerers}}` (§823) and `{{rsvpAsk}}` (§818) did, a new marker, silent in every notice approved before it and in the platform's template: `describesResultsNameAsk`, `noticeDescribesResultsNameAsk` (the notice in force names it AND `{{results}}`, in every language), `findFirstResultsNameAskNoticeVersion`, the cached twins `cachedResultsNameAskDescribed` and `cachedFirstResultsNameAskNoticeVersion`. Filled, when the notice is shown, with the tick's own words, quoted („Vreau să apar cu numele în clasament” / “I want to appear by name in the results”, `results/notice-words.ts`), with a legend entry in the legal editor in both languages. The template is **not** edited: the club and its lawyer amend the sentence about older versions and add the marker; until then nothing is asked.
- **When it is asked.** Only while the notice in force names `{{resultsNameAsk}}` and `{{results}}` in every language, only for a race (`eventTakesResults`), only of a registration whose `privacy_notice_version` is older than the first results notice, and only while the registration is active and on the public list — the name in the results follows the list's tick (§808), so a yes off the list would be a consent to nothing. One pure rule, `results/domain/name-consent.ts`, read by the page and by the server. A yes that counts is always offered the way out, whatever the notice says later and whatever the registration's state (art. 7(3) GDPR).
- **The press.** A POST (a server action), the token read and never spent, as the page's other switches (§143, §562); GET never mutates (BR-REQ-036-02 criterion 4). The server asks the gate again at every yes and refuses anything else, writing nothing. Another adult on the address may have their yes taken back from this link, never given (§421, `anotherAdultOnTheLink`); a stranger's registration is NOT_FOUND. The write sets `registrations.results_name_consent` — the column kept since §322 and unused — and `results_consent_version` to the version of the notice in force in the registration's own language (the version the form records; «Vin!»'s re-tick is the precedent), refused if that notice is below the first that named the tick, in one transaction with the row locked, and one audit row `registration.results_name_consent_changed` with the new value, the door and the notice version, never the name. A second press withdraws (the flag false, the version kept as the record of the notice the yes was given under). The results' public read is expired after the commit.
- **What the results show.** `publicResultName` names a registered runner whose registration was made under the results notice **or** who holds a consent given under a notice at or above the first that named `{{resultsNameAsk}}` (`holdsResultsNameConsent`, with `firstResultsNameAskNoticeVersion` carried beside `firstResultsNoticeVersion` into the public read, its cache key and the backoffice's «named» mark), and keeps every other condition it applied before: the list's tick, a confirmed registration, not a special guest the event hides, a name to show. A `results_name_consent` recorded under a notice that did not name the tick — a pre-§322 one, or one under a notice that only described the results — counts for nothing. A registrant under the results notice is unchanged; a runner typed by hand is unchanged (§810).
- **Telling the runners.** No new email type: the club tells them with «Trimite un mesaj participanților» (§364), and «Ghid» says so in both languages under «Publică clasamentul pe pagina evenimentului», with the order: the club and its lawyer amend the sentence and approve a notice naming the tick first. The public results' note says the older runners who asked are named too.

**Refused.** Gating on `{{results}}` (above: the template that names it tells these runners the opposite); re-ticking the list as the consent (the list's re-tick is a no-op for the already-ticked and says nothing about the results); an email of its own (the participant message already reaches them); a staff member ticking it for a runner (staff never consent for a person — they may still withdraw it, `withdrawOptionalData`'s «results»); offering it from «Înscrierile mele» (the address link cannot tell the holder from another adult on the address, as §562 found); a `/admin/tasks` row (the legend entry names the marker; the club decides whether to ask at all); and editing the legal templates — the notice's sentence «Dacă te-ai înscris sub o versiune mai veche a acestei note… apari în el doar cu numărul… chiar dacă ai bifat» is the club's and the lawyer's to amend, and the code waits for that amendment through the marker.
changelogLine: - **«Vreau să apar cu numele în clasament»** — a runner who registered under a privacy notice that did not yet describe the results can tick it on their own registration's page and is then named in a race's published results (still only while on the public list); unticked from the same page at any time. Asked only once the club approves a privacy notice that names the tick (`{{resultsNameAsk}}`) beside the results — the platform's template does not, until the club and its lawyer amend it; «Ghid» tells the club to announce it with «Trimite un mesaj participanților». §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a registration whose privacy notice predates the first that described the results, when its manage page renders while the notice in force names `{{resultsNameAsk}}` and `{{results}}` in every language, the event is a race and the registration is active and on the public list, then it shows the tick «Vreau să apar cu numele în clasament» with what is published and that it can be withdrawn; otherwise — including under a notice that names `{{results}}` alone, as the platform's template does — it is not shown, and a yes posted anyway is refused and writes nothing (2026-11-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the tick on the manage page, when it is pressed, then a POST authorised by the registration's own manage link (read, never spent) sets `results_name_consent` and `results_consent_version` to the notice version in force, writes one audit row without the name, and a second press withdraws; another adult on the address may only withdraw; a yes already held is offered the way out even after the registration is cancelled or the notice in force changes; and rendering the page writes nothing (2026-11-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a race's published results, when they are read, then an older notice's runner is «Participant #bib» without a consent, named with a consent given under a notice at or above the first that named `{{resultsNameAsk}}`, «Participant #bib» with one recorded under a notice that did not name it, and «Participant #bib» again after it is withdrawn — the list tick, a confirmed registration and the hidden guests' rule still required — and a runner who registered under the results notice is unchanged (2026-11-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Vreau să apar cu numele în clasament» for an older notice's runners, behind the notice's own marker
